about: Tracked waivers for the production dependency audit gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs). A waiver needs an owner, a reason and an expiry date; after the date the gate fails again. Remove a waiver as soon as a fixed version exists.

waivers.reason: Used only to build the PowerPoint export of a lesson in the browser from the app's own bundled pictures. The reported flaws are denial-of-service loops in image-size's JXL, HEIF and ICNS readers, which are never given a file from outside. npm offers no fixed release (its suggested change is a downgrade to 4.0.0). Re-check when pptxgenjs publishes a release that updates image-size.
Reached only through pptxgenjs (see that waiver): same reason, same expiry.
